description: The state of SOLIDWORKS as the server sees it.

state.description: not_running, multiple, starting, loading, ready, crashed or addin_unavailable.

message.description: What the state means and what to do next.

process_id.description: The SOLIDWORKS process the server talks to, or would; absent when there is none or several.

process_ids.description: Every SOLIDWORKS process in this Windows session.

responding.description: False when SOLIDWORKS' UI thread has not answered for over 5 s while nothing was running, or Windows reports its window hung; absent when not connected.

not_responding_ms.description: How long SOLIDWORKS has not responded, when responding is false.

protocol_version.description: The protocol version the add-in speaks.

answered.description: True when its client was already answered (timeout) and its outcome will come as operation.completed.

running.description: The request running on the UI thread, absent when idle.

items.description: A request waiting for the UI thread.

queued.description: Requests waiting for the UI thread, oldest first.

ui_last_pumped_ms.description: Milliseconds since the UI thread last ran the add-in's window procedure; absent before it ever has.

watchdog_alive.description: True while the watchdog thread is alive.

preferences_applied.description: True while the automation preferences are applied for a connected client.

preferences_recovered.description: True when, at load, preferences left applied by an earlier crash were restored.

preferences_not_applied.description: Automation preferences SOLIDWORKS did not take (set failed or did not stick); empty when all took.

title.description: The document's title as SOLIDWORKS shows it.

path.description: The full path, absent while the document has never been saved.

dirty.description: True when the document has unsaved changes.

documents.description: Open documents and their dirty flags, as last read.

documents_as_of.description: When the documents were last read, UTC, ISO 8601; absent before the first read.

last_event_seq.description: The sequence number of the last event raised, 0 before any.

id.description: Names this dialog until it closes; pass it to dialog.respond.

text.description: The dialog's text, one entry per static text control; empty when it could not be read.

items.description: A push button on a dialog.

text.description: The button's text, without its & accelerator marks.

control_id.description: The button's control id; dialog.respond accepts it in place of the text.

buttons.description: Its push buttons; empty when they could not be read (close still works).

request_id.description: The request that was running when it opened; absent when none was.

opened_at.description: When it was first seen, UTC, ISO 8601.

dialog.description: The modal dialog SOLIDWORKS is showing; absent when none is open.

dialog_watch_alive.description: True while the dialog watch thread is alive.

addin.description: The add-in's own state; absent when not connected.

protocol_version.description: The protocol version the add-in speaks.

title.description: The document's title as SOLIDWORKS shows it.

path.description: The full path, absent while the document has never been saved.

dirty.description: True when the document has unsaved changes.

active_document.description: The active document, absent when no document is open.

queued_requests.description: Requests waiting behind this one on SOLIDWORKS' UI thread.

session.description: The session status (active document); present only when SOLIDWORKS' UI thread was idle.

code.description: Stable error code; branch on this.

message.description: What happened and what to do next.

error.description: Why the server could not connect, when it could not.

exit_code.description: Its exit code, when Windows reported one.

at.description: When the crash was seen, UTC, ISO 8601.

items.description: A call in flight when SOLIDWORKS died.

running_ms.description: How long it had been running.

in_flight.description: The calls that were in flight.

title.description: The document's title as SOLIDWORKS shows it.

path.description: The full path, absent while the document has never been saved.

dirty.description: True when the document has unsaved changes.

dirty_documents.description: Documents that had unsaved changes in the last document table the add-in sent.

documents_as_of.description: When that document table was sent, UTC, ISO 8601; absent when none was.

last_crash.description: The last crash since the server started (or since sw_reconnect).
